title: Connect to your sync server
notice: All your devices use the same sync server. Your encrypted vault file remains available locally and offline.
routeLabel: All devices synchronize through the central server
serverHint: Enter your server with HTTPS. HTTP is allowed only for 127.0.0.1, ::1 or, after confirmation, for a WireGuard/Tailscale address. Never put vault passwords or keys into the URL.
readyHint: This server stores encrypted versions for all your devices. Other PCs do not need to be online when synchronizing. The server receives no decryption keys.

errors.unavailable: This server does not support device enrollment or the development prototype is unavailable.
errors.invalid: The input is invalid. Use your sync server's base URL without credentials, query parameters or a path.
errors.stale: This setup is no longer current. Close and reopen the dialog.
errors.connection: The server could not be confirmed. Check the URL, HTTPS certificate and availability of the Shellherd sync service. Redirects are rejected.
errors.authentication: Username or server password is wrong, or this device was removed at the server.
errors.syncLocked: Open and unlock your vault to synchronize. Close any open vault before downloading for the first time.
errors.syncChanged: The vault changed locally or externally during synchronization. Retry; those changes were not overwritten.
errors.syncHistory: Encrypted history is incomplete or invalid. The local vault will not be overwritten.
errors.syncWrongVault: Vault password, vault identity or encryption does not match. No local data was overwritten.
errors.syncRecovery: A local write did not complete unambiguously. Back up the vault and encrypted sync state and inspect recovery.
errors.syncLimit: The supported size, history or encryption profile limit was exceeded. The local vault is preserved.
errors.syncConflict: The versions require explicit conflict resolution. Existing variants are preserved.
errors.syncBindings: Configure device-specific key and file paths locally.
errors.samePassword: The server password must not be your vault password. Nothing was sent to the server.
errors.samePasswordImport: The vault password is also your server password, and that one was already sent to the server. The import was cancelled. Change the vault password on the source device and rotate the server password.
errors.identity: The device identity is damaged or unreadable. It was not replaced.
errors.limit: Too many sign-in attempts or too many devices. Wait a moment or remove an old device.
errors.syncKey: The recovery code is required for this sync.
errors.syncRecoveryCode: The recovery code is wrong or does not belong to this account. Nothing was changed.
errors.syncMigrate: The local sync state comes from an older lab version. Delete the “.sync-state” file next to the vault. Then sync again on the first device and load the vault from the server with the recovery code on every other device.
errors.enrolledElsewhere: This device is enrolled for this server at another address. Confirm the new enrollment explicitly.
errors.syncForeignKey: The account holds data of another sync key, or a new key comes from no known device. Nothing was taken over and no new code was generated. Check the server and decide which device leads before you remove foreign versions.
errors.syncOtherServer: The sync state of this vault belongs to another server. Nothing was changed. To connect this vault to this server, delete the file “.sync-state” next to the vault.
errors.syncPlatform: In this development stage, synchronization is available on Linux only.
errors.invite: The enrollment code is wrong, expired or already used. Create a new one on the enrolled device.
errors.enrollmentLocked: This server accepts new devices only with an enrollment code. Create it on an enrolled device.
errors.syncRotated: The sync key was renewed on another device. Enter the new recovery code from the device that renewed it. An old code does not open the new key. Your local vault stays unchanged.
errors.syncRotateBlocked: Before renewing, the sync must be complete without conflicts and without pending local changes. Sync first.
errors.syncRotateRaced: Another device renewed the sync key at the same time. Nothing was changed. Sync and try again.
errors.syncRoster: The server’s device list contradicts the one stored last: a known device has another key. Nothing was synced. Check the server.
errors.syncInviteKey: The sync key from the enrollment code is no longer on the server, for example because ten minutes have passed or the key was renewed. Enter the recovery code.

passwordHint: Only for enrolling this device once. Afterwards the device authenticates with its key. Use a different password than for your vault.
manualNotice: Synchronization starts when you click. An encrypted backup is created before local changes are applied. New or changed connections may need local approval.
localVaultHint: For the first load on this device: the recovery code from the first device and a new password for the local vault file. Both stay local. Received connections start disabled.
bindingsNeeded: The received version needs local key or kubeconfig paths. The local vault remains unchanged.
conflictsKept: Synchronization has conflicts. Both versions remain encrypted; your local vault has not been overwritten.
approvalsNeeded: New or changed connections need local approval before use.
keepLocalHint: This choice keeps local connection settings for all reported connection conflicts. Independent server changes are still applied. Other versions remain in encrypted history.
keepLocal: Keep my connection settings for conflicts
skipped_one: {{count}} foreign or unreadable object was skipped.
skipped_other: {{count}} foreign or unreadable objects were skipped.

privateNetwork.label: Private network (WireGuard/Tailscale): allow HTTP
privateNetwork.hint: Only for a WireGuard or Tailscale address of this server. Outside such a tunnel the network could read the server password and data. Your vault password stays local.

compacted_one: {{count}} older version was compacted and removed from the server.
compacted_other: {{count}} older versions were compacted and removed from the server.
removeForeignHint: Removes objects from an older lab version that cannot be read with this account's sync key. A server account holds exactly one vault.
enrolledHint: This device is enrolled at the server. The session opens with its key, no password needed.
enrolledElsewhere: This device is enrolled for this server at {{url}}. A foreign server can pose as your server by reporting the same server ID. Enroll this device here only if you are sure that both addresses belong to your server.
identityTemporary: Temporary device identity: without an operating-system key store this device's enrollment lasts only until the server or the app restarts, or for twelve hours.
recoveryCodeNew: Write this code down now. It is shown only once. Another device needs it to load your vault from the server. The server does not know it. It opens only the current sync key; after “Renew sync key” a new code applies.
recoveryCodeNoted: I have written the code down
recoveryCodeHint: Written down on the first device. It unlocks the sync key locally only.
syncKeyNeeded: This device does not have the sync key yet. Enter the recovery code.
newVaultPassword: New vault password for the local file
revokeHint: A removed device loses server access immediately. It keeps its local vault. Renew the sync key afterwards so it can no longer read new data.
unknownAuthors_one: {{count}} version comes from a device the server no longer knows.
unknownAuthors_other: {{count}} versions come from devices the server no longer knows.
quarantined_one: {{count}} version from a removed device was not applied.
quarantined_other: {{count}} versions from removed devices were not applied.
enrolledElsewhereConfirm: I have checked the address and enroll this device here again.
removeForeignVersions: Also remove encrypted versions created with another sync key
removeForeignVersionsHint: Such versions come from a device with its own sync key or from an aborted setup. A device that still syncs with that other key loses its server history. Its local vault is kept.
deviceNameHint: 1–64 characters: letters, digits, spaces and - _ . , ( ) '. No run of 8 or more characters from 0–9 and a–f, not even separated by spaces, because it looks like a verification code.
inviteCodeHint: Created on an already enrolled device via “Invite device”. Valid for ten minutes and exactly once. It gives this device the enrollment and the sync key; no server password is needed.
inviteDeviceHint: Creates an enrollment code for a new device. Enter it there under “With enrollment code”. The server does not know the code.
inviteCodeTitle: Enrollment code for a new device
inviteCodeNew: Enter this code on the new device within ten minutes. It is shown only once and is valid exactly once.
inviteCodeDone: I have entered the code there
importWithInviteHint: This device was enrolled with an enrollment code and holds the sync key. Choose only a new password for the local vault file.
rotateKeyHint: Creates a new sync key and a new recovery code. All data is stored on the server again under the new key, the old data is removed. Removed devices, old codes and old server copies can no longer read anything new. Your other devices need the new code at their next sync.
rotateKeyConfirm: Renew the sync key? Your other devices will need the new recovery code afterwards. Sync on all devices first so nothing ends in a conflict.
rotationAdvised: A device was removed. Renew the sync key so it can no longer read new data.
deviceEnrolledByUnknown: enrolled with a code from a device that is no longer known
newDevice: New device in the account: {{name}} ({{how}}). If you did not enroll it yourself, remove it, change the server password and renew the sync key.
deviceRevived: {{name}} was removed and is active again according to the server. This device keeps treating it as removed until you confirm.
ownInviteDevice: Signed in with your enrollment code: {{name}}. If that was not you, remove the device, change the server password and renew the sync key.
